mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, title, content, order_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{orderId}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} OR user_id IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM notification WHERE (user_id = #{userId} OR user_id IS NULL) AND status = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notification SET status = #{status} WHERE user_id = #{userId} OR user_id IS NULL
